classes._note: MapChunks puts each batch in a class: by_type "<source>/<type>" first, then "<source>/<kind>" (a decor type "<kind>_<n>" without its _<n>), then by_source. range_m: every piece of the batch is drawn at least out to this camera distance; 0 = never culled.
